liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **intro music - What Are You Doing New Years Eve**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Move On Up (Curtis Mayfield)**: back after 26 archived shows (514 days); rare: 10 archived performances [15]
- **You're All I Need (marvin gaye)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Express Yourself (charles wright)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Wonderful Man**: back after 28 archived shows (665 days); rare: 10 archived performances [15]
- **Look At You**: rare: 13 archived performances [15]
- **Touch Me Part 2**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 7 archived performances [15]
- **The Wanderer (Dion)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **mmj2008-12-31** (recommended): audience recording; 36 songs; 190 min; rated 4.41/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds good considering the venue; Listener experiences chills upon re-listening to the recording; Tape sounds great considering the listener's standing position [5][7][8][9][11]
- **mmj2008-12-31.flac24**: audience recording; 36 songs; 190 min; rated 1.25/5 by 4 [2]

## Around the show

- Charlie Chaplin's Little Dictator played during intermission; audience skated [4]
- White Ties & Tails dressed like Clockwork Orange droogs [4]
- Band performed Get Down On It at MSG [6]
- Listener recently heard Leroy Justice perform the same cover song [14]
- Band pulled off the cavernous Garden despite smaller venue history [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2008-12-31**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: Audience [1]. Also: Horn section included Stephen Bernstein, Jeff Coffin, Oscar Otterstrom, David Pietro; Nicole Atkins sang vocals; Will Johnson played guitar [1]
- **mmj2008-12-31.flac24**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: Audience [2]. Also: 24-bit fileset not intended for CD burning or MP3 downloading [2]
